I can do quite a lot. Here's what I have access to:

**Files & Code**
- Read, write, edit files in your workspace
- Search with grep/glob patterns
- Run shell commands, scripts, background tasks
- Manage Git repos, GitHub issues/PRs (via `gh` CLI)

**Web & Browser**
- Fetch content from URLs
- Automate browser tasks (login, click, fill forms, scrape)
- Take screenshots, interact with web apps

**Messages & Channels**
- Send/receive on Signal, Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, iMessage, Slack, Google Chat
- Manage polls, reactions, replies
- Cross-session messaging

**Your Data**
- Apple Notes, Bear Notes, Obsidian vaults
- Apple Reminders, Things 3 tasks
- Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets)
- Email via Himalaya (IMAP/SMTP)

**Automation**
- Schedule reminders/cron jobs
- Run background tasks
- Spawn sub-agents for parallel work

**Devices & Home**
- Control Hue lights, Sonos speakers
- Capture from cameras
- Node management (location, screen recording, notifications)

**AI & Media**
- Image analysis, generation, editing
- Transcription (Whisper)
- TTS (text-to-speech)
- Summarize URLs, podcasts, videos

**Specialized Skills**
- Social media (X/Twitter, LinkedIn engagement)
- 1Password secrets
- Weather, food orders, PDF editing
- Coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode)

What do you need?
